introduction: Delaware 211 connects residents with local food, housing, utility and other services. It offers free, confidential help in multiple languages.
description: Delaware 211 connects residents with local food, housing, utility and other services. It offers free, confidential help in multiple languages.

sections.who: Anyone looking for Delaware community services can use the directory. Individual providers set their own conditions.
sections.get: You receive referrals, not an approval or reserved funding. Phone and live-chat hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–7 p.m.

sections.apply:
1. Contact a navigator

    Call 211 or text your ZIP code to 898-211. Live chat and directory search are available at Delaware 211.

  2. Explain the need

    Mention shutoff notices, lack of food or other immediate concerns.

  3. Check the referral

    Ask the provider about intake hours, available help and required evidence.
sections.after: Keep referral details and request alternatives if a provider cannot help.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Delaware 211 contact and service information. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
